smart-campus-parking-system-178983851723.problem: Campus drivers waste time searching for parking due to lack of real-time occupancy data. functional_requirements.title: Historical Logging & Utilization
functional_requirements.description: Firebase shall store each occupancy change event; dashboard shall show daily/weekly utilization charts and average search-time estimate.

functional_requirements.title: Pre-Arrival Availability Check
functional_requirements.description: Public dashboard URL shall allow users to view current availability before entering campus without authentication.

functional_requirements.title: Sensor Health Monitoring
functional_requirements.description: System shall flag sensors missing heartbeats >30 s and show maintenance alerts on dashboard.

non_functional_requirements.title: End-to-End Latency

non_functional_requirements.title: Prototype Cost Ceiling

non_functional_requirements.title: Offline Resilience
non_functional_requirements.description: ESP32 shall buffer ≥1 h of events locally and auto-sync when connectivity restores.

non_functional_requirements.title: Scalable Data Model
non_functional_requirements.description: Firestore schema shall support future expansion to 500+ slots without migration.

constraints: Only 4 physical parking slots for demonstration
No access to real parking facility
Tech stack locked to ESP32, React, Firebase

edgekws-2-0-low-latency-voice-activator-.problem: Develop an on-device keyword spotting system for the wake word 'Dear Folk' using ESP32-S3 and INMP441 microphone to enable low-latency voice activation without continuous audio transmission to remote servers, reducing bandwidth and latency while operating under tight hardware and budget constraints.

functional_requirements.title: Wake Word Detection
functional_requirements.description: The system must detect the wake word 'Dear Folk' from 16 kHz I2S audio input using an INT8 TensorFlow Lite Micro model with inference latency under 200 ms.

functional_requirements.title: Audio Capture and Preprocessing
functional_requirements.description: The system must capture mono audio via I2S from INMP441 microphone at 16 kHz, apply necessary preprocessing (e.g., framing, normalization) compatible with the TFLite model input format.

functional_requirements.title: Post-Detection Activation
functional_requirements.description: Upon wake word detection, the system must trigger a signal to enable audio streaming to a remote ASR service (e.g., via Firebase or HTTP) within 50 ms of detection.

functional_requirements.title: Model Inference on ESP32-S3
functional_requirements.description: The INT8 TFLite model must run entirely on the ESP32-S3 using TensorFlow Lite Micro, with peak RAM usage under 256 KB and CPU utilization allowing real-time processing.

functional_requirements.title: Low-Power Operation
functional_requirements.description: The system must minimize power consumption during idle listening, aiming for average current draw under 15 mA to support battery-operated edge deployment.

non_functional_requirements.title: Latency Requirement
non_functional_requirements.description: End-to-end latency from wake word utterance to detection signal must not exceed 300 ms to ensure responsive user interaction.

non_functional_requirements.title: Model Size Constraint
non_functional_requirements.description: The quantized INT8 TensorFlow Lite model must fit within the ESP32-S3's available RAM (≤ 512 KB) and flash (≤ 4 MB) to allow room for OS and audio buffers.

non_functional_requirements.title: Robustness to Noise
non_functional_requirements.description: The system must maintain ≥ 80% true positive rate and ≤ 10% false accept rate in mild background noise (e.g., 60 dB ambient) to ensure usability in real environments.

non_functional_requirements.title: Development and Deployment Simplicity
non_functional_requirements.description: The system must be programmable using Arduino IDE or PlatformIO with minimal external dependencies to support student developers and rapid iteration.

constraints: ESP32-S3 limited RAM (~512 KB) and processing power for real-time audio inference
Student budget restricts access to premium hardware or cloud training resources
Limited training data for the wake word 'Dear Folk' may affect model accuracy
Real-time audio processing requires deterministic timing and I2S DMA reliability
INT8 quantization must preserve model accuracy while enabling deployment on microcontroller
assumptions: The INMP441 microphone provides stable 16-bit I2S audio at 16 kHz without significant hardware noise or dropout
An INT8 TFLite model for 'Dear Folk' can be trained or converted to achieve acceptable accuracy (>80% TP, <10% FA) with limited data
Firebase or similar service can be used for lightweight signaling or audio upload post-detection without complex authentication overhead
open_questions: What is the minimum acceptable model size and architecture (e.g., depthwise separable CNN) that achieves target accuracy on 'Dear Folk' with INT8 quantization?
How will false activations be mitigated in noisy environments without significantly increasing latency or power consumption?
What is the optimal audio buffering strategy (frame size, hop length) to balance latency, memory use, and feature extraction quality for keyword spotting on ESP32-S3?

test-nebius-migration-project.summary: Execution plan organized into four milestones over 8 weeks: (1) Foundations & Architecture Gap Resolution (Weeks 1-2) to define MVP scale, regulatory artifacts, and onboard compute budget; (2) Core Control Plane Implementation (Weeks 3-5) building telemetry ingress, Redis state store, path planner, and deconfliction engine with deterministic 50ms cycles; (3) Fleet API & Integration (Weeks 5-6) delivering dispatch interface and end-to-end data flow; (4) Validation, Hardening & MVP Delivery (Weeks 7-8) running latency/load tests, failsafe demonstrations, and regulatory artifact generation. Critical path flows through gap resolution → state-store → telemetry-ingress → path-planner → deconfliction → fleet-api → integration test → latency validation.

milestones.title: Foundations & Architecture Gap Resolution
milestones.description: Resolve open architecture gaps: define MVP/scale drone counts, engage regulatory liaison for certification artifacts, benchmark onboard failsafe compute budget. Establish repo structure, CI/CD, and development environment.

milestones.title: Core Control Plane Implementation
milestones.description: Implement Redis state store with streams/pubsub schemas, telemetry ingress service with mTLS/WebSocket/CBOR, real-time path planner with 50ms A* cycle, and distributed deconfliction engine with velocity obstacle method. All components wired via Redis blocking reads for deterministic timing.

milestones.title: Fleet API & End-to-End Integration
milestones.description: Build Dispatch & Fleet Management REST/WebSocket API, integrate GPS-RTK correction bridge, and wire full telemetry→plan→deconflict→command loop. Implement operator override and geofence management flows.

milestones.title: Validation, Hardening & MVP Delivery
milestones.description: Execute sub-100ms latency validation under 50-drone simulated load, demonstrate offline failsafe triggers at 200ms link loss, generate regulatory audit logs, and deliver MVP with documentation.

tasks.title: Define MVP and Scale Drone Counts with Load Test Plan
tasks.description: Produce written decision: MVP = 10 concurrent drones, Scale Target = 50. Define Redis stream sharding strategy (single stream per drone vs. partitioned), planner parallelism model (single-threaded 50ms cycle vs. worker pool), and deconfliction complexity class (O(N^2) pairwise vs. spatial indexing). Document in ARCHITECTURE_DECISIONS.md.
success_criteria: Written decision document with MVP=10, Scale=50

tasks.title: Engage Regulatory Liaison and Document Certification Artifacts
tasks.description: Schedule meeting with aviation authority contact. Produce REGULATORY_ARTIFACTS.md listing required evidence: deterministic replan logs, failsafe demonstration video, telemetry latency histograms, mTLS certificate chain, geofence enforcement logs. Define log schema additions to Redis state-store for audit trail.

tasks.title: Benchmark Onboard Failsafe Compute Budget on Target Hardware
tasks.description: Deploy ROS2 failsafe node (return-to-base, emergency landing, hold pattern) on Jetson Orin/NX. Measure worst-case execution time, memory footprint, and CPU utilization. Document results in ONBOARD_BENCHMARK.md. If exceeds budget, define reduced failsafe scope for MVP.
success_criteria: Failsafe node deployed on target hardware

tasks.title: Initialize Repository, CI/CD, and Development Environment
tasks.description: Create monorepo with services: telemetry-ingress, path-planner, deconfliction, fleet-api, state-store-config. Configure GitHub Actions for lint (ruff), type-check (mypy), unit tests (pytest), and Docker image builds. Provision local Redis cluster (3-node sentinel) via docker-compose. Add pre-commit hooks.
success_criteria: CI pipeline passing on empty services
Local Redis cluster running via docker-compose

tasks.title: Implement Redis State Store Schemas and Lua Atomic Scripts
tasks.description: Define Redis key schemas: telemetry:{drone_id} (Stream), trajectory:{drone_id} (Hash), geofence:{id} (JSON), drone_registry (Hash), auth_nonces (Set), audit_log (Stream). Write Lua scripts for: atomic trajectory write with version increment, telemetry freshness validation, command stream append with TTL. Load scripts into Redis at startup via SCRIPT LOAD.
success_criteria: All key schemas documented in STATE_STORE_SCHEMA.md
Scripts load successfully on Redis startup
Atomic trajectory write verified under concurrency

tasks.title: Build Telemetry Ingress Service with mTLS/WebSocket/CBOR
tasks.description: Implement FastAPI service with WebSocket endpoint /telemetry/{drone_id}. Enforce mTLS with client cert validation against CA. Decode CBOR frames (position, velocity, battery, health). Validate schema + freshness (timestamp < 200ms). Write to Redis stream via XADD. Read downlink command stream via blocking XREAD and push frames to drone. Implement auth logging to audit stream.
success_criteria: mTLS handshake succeeds with valid client cert
Telemetry frames appear in Redis stream < 5ms after receipt
Downlink commands pushed to WebSocket < 5ms after Redis write
Auth logs written to audit stream

tasks.title: Implement Real-Time Path Planner with 50ms A* Cycle
tasks.description: Build planner service: blocking XREAD on telemetry + weather + geofence + obstacle keys. Compute 3D A* with dynamic cost map (weather penalties, no-fly zones, obstacle inflation). Budget: 50ms wall-clock per cycle. Output trajectory waypoints + cost map version to Redis via atomic Lua script. Publish replan trigger to Pub/Sub. Implement deterministic loop: sleep until next 50ms boundary. Log cycle timing histogram to audit stream.
success_criteria: Planner reads consistent snapshot each cycle
Replan trigger published on significant deviation

tasks.title: Implement Distributed Deconfliction Engine with Velocity Obstacle Method
tasks.description: Build deconfliction service: consume trajectory versions + live telemetry positions + intent broadcasts (Pub/Sub). For each drone pair within 500m, compute velocity obstacle separation. If predicted minimum separation < 50m, generate hold/reroute command. Write deconflicted trajectories + alerts to Redis streams atomically. Publish separation alerts. Cycle budget: 30ms (leaves 20ms margin in 50ms control loop).
success_criteria: Velocity obstacle computation completes within 30ms (p99) for N=50
No separation violations in 1-hour simulated flight

tasks.title: Build Dispatch & Fleet Management REST/WebSocket API
tasks.description: Implement FastAPI service with endpoints: POST /packages (assignment), GET /drones (status), POST /geofences (create/update), WS /fleet (real-time dashboard), POST /override (operator command). Auth via JWT + mTLS. Write intent to Redis (task assignments, geofence edits). Read aggregated state for dashboards. Implement command signing with hardware-backed keys (simulated via HSM library).
success_criteria: Package assignment creates task in Redis
Drone status dashboard reflects live telemetry
Geofence edits propagate to planner within 100ms
Operator override signed and written to command stream

tasks.title: Integrate GPS-RTK Correction Bridge into Downlink
tasks.description: Implement ROS2 ntrip_client bridge: subscribe to RTCM corrections topic, multiplex into downlink telemetry frames via Redis command stream. Telemetry ingress reads corrections and embeds in CBOR downlink frames. Verify cm-level positioning improvement in simulation.
success_criteria: RTCM corrections received from ROS2 topic

tasks.title: Wire End-to-End Data Flow and Validate Loop Timing
tasks.description: Deploy all services (ingress, planner, deconfliction, fleet-api) against local Redis cluster. Run simulated drone fleet (10 drones) publishing telemetry at 10Hz. Measure end-to-end latency: drone telemetry → ingress → Redis → planner → deconfliction → command stream → ingress → drone. Verify < 100ms p99. Log full loop timing breakdown per stage.

tasks.title: Execute Sub-100ms Latency Validation Under 50-Drone Simulated Load
tasks.description: Scale simulator to 50 concurrent drones. Run 30-minute soak test. Capture p50/p95/p99 latency histograms for: ingress write, planner cycle, deconfliction cycle, command delivery. Verify Redis CPU/memory stable. Document results in LATENCY_VALIDATION_REPORT.md. If p99 > 100ms, optimize hot paths (Lua scripts, CBOR codec, A* heuristic).
success_criteria: Redis resource usage stable (no OOM, CPU < 70%)
Report documents all percentiles and bottlenecks

tasks.title: Demonstrate Offline Failsafe Trigger at 200ms Link Loss
tasks.description: Configure simulator to drop telemetry link for selected drone at t=0. Verify onboard ROS2 failsafe node triggers at 200ms (configurable threshold). Capture failsafe execution: return-to-base trajectory, emergency landing site selection, or hold pattern. Log failsafe decision latency and actuator commands. Produce FAILSAFE_DEMO.md with video evidence for regulator.
success_criteria: Actuator commands issued within 50ms of trigger

Critical path flows through gap resolution → state-store → telemetry-ingress → path-planner → deconfliction → fleet-api → integration test → latency validation.
